steps.executor_prompt: Determine the OTP source from the target's visible challenge. If it says the code was sent by email, open the available email app, refresh the inbox, and read the newest matching verification message. If it requests an authenticator code, open the available authenticator app and read the matching current code, waiting for the next code if expiration is near. Discover the appropriate installed app when its name is not specified; do not ask the user to identify it. Report only the OTP code.

Return from the OTP source to the exact target using Back or Recents, then confirm the target app or browser domain and its open OTP challenge. The target is the one named in the task; do not stop or ask the user to identify it merely because the OTP source is foreground. In a browser, locate the existing target tab; if the challenge is no longer open, navigate to the stated target and repeat the login to restore it. Enter the retrieved OTP, verify the complete code is present, submit it, and resolve target-owned confirmation prompts. Report success only after a separate observation shows account-specific authenticated content or an explicit login-success confirmation. If the code is rejected, request one new code, return to the OTP source, refresh it, and use only a matching message newer than the resend request before returning to the target and submitting it.
